text:
maya: Quick async sync — Optimize toolkit delivery: where are we on quant recommendations + batching/caching? Need owners for rollout gates, PR reviews, and there's a regression alert firing on eval-suite A. @liam @arjun pls weigh in.

liam: Working through quant profiles today. Left notes on the shared sheet. Main blocker right now is runtime perf on 8k sequences with int8 — seeing latency spikes in the tail.

arjun: I can take the runtime perf investigation. Which model variant are we testing? Also need the canary logs to start reproducing.

maya: rwd-7b-q4a for the first pass. @ella can you confirm cache defaults? Regression in eval-suite A shows coherence dip on long prompts (~>1k tokens).

ella: I'll review cache TTL and prefix caching heuristics. Quick q: are we enabling per-route KV cache or a global cache? I lean per-route to avoid cross-tenant pollution.

devon: FYI I opened a small PR for batching config + target-latency knobs: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/842 — needs review, adds a config block and a flag to opt into prefix caching.

liam: On the eval regression — looks like quantization shift nudged logits for tail tokens. Repro snippet I used locally:

```
# repro sketch
from infer import Client
c = Client(model="rwd-7b")
out_float = c.generate(prompt, model_variant="float")
out_q = c.generate(prompt, model_variant="q4a")
print(out_float.top_tokens()[:10], out_q.top_tokens()[:10])
```

Top-k differences are subtle but enough to drop some metrics.

arjun: I'll run that repro on dedicated infra and compare p50/p95/p99. Can someone dump the canary traces?

ops-bot: canary logs: https://logs.redwood/run/2026-03-16/canary-2233334444 — contains perf traces and kv-cache stats. :eyes:

maya: Owners plan: @arjun -> runtime perf investigation & repro; @ella -> cache policy + TTLs; @liam -> quant recommendation writeup + eval triage; @devon -> PR followup & add config toggle. Milestone: gate by EOD Friday for canary -> gradual rollout. If blockers, escalate to shiproom.

liam: Quick perf note: local batch=8 reduced p99 by ~18% but pushed median up ~6ms. Need to tune batching window + batching timeout. Will post a small table later.

ella: Agree per-route cache. Proposing defaults: chat endpoints TTL=30s, streaming fragments TTL=5s, cache key includes route+user-seg. Also will add a per-route toggle in the routing layer.

devon: Added TODO in PR: "add per-route-cache toggle" and flagged @maya for review. If we want to gate by config, I can add the runtime flag.

maya: Can we also add a regression-alert rule: if eval-suite A coherence drops >2% or rouge/metric X drops >2%, block rollout and notify #incidents + oncall? @eng-sre FYI.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment for rwd-7b-q4a started at 2026-03-16T14:10Z, 50 req/s shadow traffic. Monitoring hooks attached.

liam: I'll attach perf table + a short writeup of quant tradeoffs in the delivery doc by EOD.

arjun: Repro started on dedicated infra — will post logs in this thread when done. If I hit environment mismatch, I'll ping infra.

ella: I'll put cache config PR up after I confirm defaults.

maya: Thanks all — consolidating owners + action items in the delivery tracker now. If anyone hits a hard blocker, call it out here and we'll get a quick sync. :thumbsup:
